Conditions

HAPPY THANKSGIVING MOUNTAIN HIGH FAMILY! 11/26 - 9AM-4PM

Come have some fun, and continue the opening week kick off of the 26/27 Season at Mountain High! The weather is going to be beautiful again! Partly Sunny, increasing clouds with a high near 58. Wind chill values as low as 30 early with Northeast winds around 10 mph. So, bring those layers and sunscreen, and get ready for some fun in the sun to shred in some spring like conditions.

2 lifts will be available, accessing beginner to intermediate terrain on Upper Chisolm, Lower Chisolm, Cruiser, and Sunnyside. Make sure to hit our terrain park with 6 features on Cruiser.

Coverage is good with a 1-2' base of fresh, machine-made snow. Early-season and thin cover conditions do exist so, please stay on open groomed trails and obey all posted signs.

Our season pass sale is still going on until November 30th! Don't miss out on those great prices.
As always be safe and have a great day

Road Conditions

Hwy 2 from Hwy 138 - OPEN WITH NO RESTRICTIONS.
Largo Vista/Big Pines Hwy - OPEN WITH NO RESTRICTIONS.
